field_text_formatted.value: The deprecated DruxtField components are off unless you set druxt.entity.components.fields: true, and a consola 2.15.3 pin can go. Wrapper components no longer render module data as HTML attributes, so entity="[object Object]" is gone from your markup. Wrappers still read it from $attrs. The rest is in the changelog on druxtjs.org.
